title: Explicit ECDSA Digital Signature Generation
description: Tests explicit JCA Signature instantiation with SHA256withECDSA algorithm.

expected_findings.evaluation_notes: Scanners must extract ECDSA algorithm with associated digest SHA-256 (from SHA256withECDSA). Schema limitation: answer_key.schema.json does not define a separate digest_algorithm parameter field, so SHA-256 is explicitly represented in variant 'SHA256withECDSA' and documented in evaluation notes. Operational role is determinable as digital_signature based on Signature API usage.

verification_metadata.verification_method: Manual Source Code Inspection & JCA Spec Cross-Check
